paragraphs.label: Mở thư và lời khuyên
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in walking as a daily habit. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

Thanks for your email. I am glad you told me about your interest in [chủ đề]. You asked for advice, so I have a few suggestions that you might find helpful. You do not need to do everything at once.

paragraphs.text: If I were you, I would start by joining a neighbourhood walking event. There, you could explore a short local route and note useful improvements.
